DISCIPLINE options

Connection

Your XP and streak live inside the extension, so the website reads the same score wherever you open it. Nothing leaves your browser.

Blocking

The extension ships with the default blocklist baked in, and pulls your custom list from the dashboard on every sync.

How XP works

  • 25 XP for every clean day, plus a streak bonus that grows to +60 XP/day at 30 days.
  • Milestone bonuses at 1, 3, 7, 14, 21, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 180, 270 and 365 days.
  • Up to 5 XP × 5 per day for beating urges.
  • Levels cost more XP each time. Ranks run Recruit → Monk Mode → Iron Will → Ascended → Legend.
